**这是个关键发现**——Reddit 要关掉 RSS 了。必须拿到准确日期，这直接影响我的脚本。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'text/html'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function strip(s){ return String(s||'').replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim(); }",
 "(async function(){",
 " const urls=[",
 " 'https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-reddit-rss-public-api-shutdown/',",
 " 'https://www.medianama.com/2026/10/223-reddit-rss-feeds-public-api-bots/'",
 " ];",
 " for(const u of urls){",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get(u);",
 " const s=strip(r.body);",
 " console.log('=== '+u.substring(0,60)+' -> '+r.status+' len='+s.length);",
 " // 找日期和关键句",
 " const idx=s.search(/November|RSS/i);",
 " console.log(s.substring(Math.max(0,idx-200), idx+1800));",
 " console.log('');",
 " }catch(e){ console.log(u+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,4000)});",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rd.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rd.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Reddit RSS shutdown details", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 8000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'text/html'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "function strip(s){ return String(s||'').replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim(); }",
  "(async function(){",
  "  const urls=[",
  "    'https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-reddit-rss-public-api-shutdown/',",
  "    'https://www.medianama.com/2026/10/223-reddit-rss-feeds-public-api-bots/'",
  "  ];",
  "  for(const u of urls){",
  "    try{",
  "      const r=await get(u);",
  "      const s=strip(r.body);",
  "      console.log('=== '+u.substring(0,60)+' -> '+r.status+' len='+s.length);",
  "      // 找日期和关键句",
  "      const idx=s.search(/November|RSS/i);",
  "      console.log(s.substring(Math.max(0,idx-200), idx+1800));",
  "      console.log('');",
  "    }catch(e){ console.log(u+' ERR '+e.message); }",
  "    await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,4000)});",
  "  }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rd.cjs", content: js });

const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Reddit RSS shutdown details", timeoutMs: 260000 });
